title: Chinese Steamed Cod with Ginger, Spring Onion and Soy
summary: A light Cantonese-style steamed cod dish with fragrant ginger, fresh spring onion and a savoury soy-sesame dressing. It is quick enough for a weeknight dinner and best served with rice and greens.

ingredients.name: fresh ginger, cut into fine matchsticks

steps: Pat the cod fillets dry and place them on a heatproof plate that fits inside your steamer. Season with a pinch of salt and black pepper, then scatter half of the ginger over the fish.
Set up a steamer over simmering water. Steam the cod for 8–10 minutes, depending on thickness, until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
While the fish steams, mix the soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a small bowl until the sugar mostly dissolves.
Carefully lift the plate from the steamer and spoon away any excess watery liquid. Scatter the remaining ginger and the shredded spring onions over the hot cod.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan until shimmering but not smoking. Pour it carefully over the spring onions and ginger so they sizzle and soften.
Spoon the soy-sesame dressing over the fish, garnish with coriander, and serve immediately.
